scope: Functional browser regression on an isolated Brave profile via CDP9223. Synthetic .test requests are intercepted by Playwright; backend request/304 behavior is covered separately by proxy unit tests. This is not a performance measurement.

same_url_regression.trigger: Change an IMG fetch mode with crossOrigin=anonymous and assign its existing src. This causes a real same-URL network refetch; an ordinary same-src setter can reuse the active decoded-image cache.
assertions: An old checked status response is held while the new same-URL image request starts.
The old response does not settle the new generation; another status poll occurs.
The image is still incomplete and its waiting indicator is visible before release.
The new unavailable result is shown after the response completes.
Image URL and layout dimensions remain unchanged.

other_browser_assertions: Subtle pending indicator; approved badges hidden; filtered, unavailable and inline-background labels.
Click-through; removal cleanup; bounded long-URL batches; late-visible images checked.

negative_control.change: Remove only the generation comparison from the status-response guard, in the test process without editing product files.
negative_control.result: Expected failure: the stale checked reply settles the restarted image and suppresses its next status poll.

capture_note: Four direct CDP screenshots timed out as recorded in capture_errors. All browser behavior assertions passed; no same-url-pending screenshot was produced. Existing checking and background captures succeeded.
proxy_and_node_validation: 57 passed, no skips: test_image_status.py and test_page_filter.py, including Node syntax/behavior checks. Coverage includes request-stage invalidation, same-level unexpired 304 restoration, stale/in-flight policy levels, and unchanged video304 refusal.
